extension.summary: Unofficial Tastemade videos and optional live TV
extension.description:
Browse VOD shows, movies, seasons and episodes with programme artwork, summaries and clear navigation.
Use an eligible Tastemade account to play entitled, provider-declared unencrypted HLS videos. Your profile can reuse its viewing session, verify sign-in and sign out locally.
Optional live TV opens the current channel list directly and uses compatible InputStream Adaptive. Live TV is off by default; installation or enabling is offered only with your consent when you choose Play.
Keeps Kodi's native views and playback controls. Includes original generic icon and background artwork, not official service branding.
extension.disclaimer: Independent, unofficial add-on; not affiliated with or endorsed by Tastemade. Service/content names identify their respective owners. Eligible account permissions are required; no purchase, DRM or region bypass is provided. Password masking does not encrypt saved settings. Media/session URLs may appear in native Kodi or player logs; review logs before sharing and protect reusable credentials. Original artwork is not a legal guarantee of trademark clearance.
extension.news: Prepared the permanent plugin.video.tastemade identity and standalone installation guide. Earlier development builds use a separate settings profile; sign in again after installing this add-on. Includes VOD and season browsing, optional direct InputStream Adaptive live TV and original icon/fanart.

extension.description: Reviewed independent add-ons, selected by Kodi version.

extension.summary: Channels DVR Hub: Dashboard, guide, recordings and passes for Kodi
extension.description: Channels DVR Hub is an ALPHA client for Kodi 21 Omega. It connects to a configured Channels DVR and provides a Dashboard, full-screen Guide, Recordings, DVR management, Search and Settings. Search covers bounded loaded listings. Playback uses Kodi with full-screen as the default and optional background browsing. Live tuning requires explicit confirmation. Scheduling and supported pass actions use separate review and provider readback.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial ALPHA add-on for Kodi 21 Omega only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Channels or Fancy Bits, LLC. Project support: https://github.com/kcook98765/script.channelsdvr.hub/issues . Playback, scheduling, pass management and connected DVR behavior have not been natively accepted for this release. Use only your own authorized DVR and content with the required subscription and server build. Channels DVR may use another available source. Preview matches do not guarantee future coverage. Saved rules stay on the DVR after you exit Kodi. Private operation history is retained; no automatic changes or retries.
extension.news: 0.2.0 ALPHA owner-review candidate: Modernized Hub navigation, full-screen Guide, recording categories, unified DVR and Search, startup and browsing preferences, and native playback presentation options. Real live TV acceptance and compact Now Playing controls remain pending.

extension.summary: Fullscreen XMLTV programme guide with channel and stream mapping.
extension.description: Maintained modernization Beta of TV Guide Fullscreen: XMLTV listings, stream mappings, search, reminders and ordinary AutoPlay. Stream Setup tabs show their contents in Default, Dark and CatBar, including Browse and Addons. Thanks for the major contributions from: iainmacleod, im85288, RayW1986, bluezed, andy, Zomboided, tycoo, kjb86, Doctor-Eggs
extension.disclaimer: Based on the original TV Guide addon by twinther, FTV Guide and Midraal's fork.
extension.news: 0.1.3 Beta prepared, pending owner publication: same-path XMLTV refresh with saved guide settings and mappings retained; subtitle and strict category-scoped search; native Favorites return; category mouse interaction and membership order. Fresh XMLTV declaration order applies unless explicit M3U ordering is enabled; saved weights and visibility stay. Ordinary title misses in #86 remain open. Planned for Nexus/Omega; Matrix startup remains blocked and Piers is preview-only. Versioned ZIP native qualification is pending.

extension.description: Aura is highly customisable skin with multiple widgets and a horizontal home menu. Aura combines the minimalism and rounded edges of Arctic Zephyr with the sleek customisability of Horizon. Whilst the best Aura experience is had with a remote, Aura has been designed to accomodate mouse and touch users where possible.

Aura ist ein sehr anpassbarer Skin mit mehreren Widgets und einem horizontalen Home-Menü. Aura kombiniert den Minimalismus und die abgerundeten Kanten von Arctic Zephyr mit der eleganten Anpassungsfähigkeit von Horizon. Während das beste Aura-Erlebnis mit einer Fernbedienung geboten wird, wurde Aura so konzipiert, dass es auch Maus- und Touch-Benutzern nach Möglichkeit entgegenkommt.
